utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just about to ask what still needs fixing. I can help out if you point me to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. The porch light and the loose gate latch still need fixing, if you don’t mind taking a look.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll take a look at the porch light first, then the gate latch if I can manage it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still checking who can help, but I’ll pass along the latest as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly the porch step and the loose fence gate. I can write the rest down if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please write the rest down—what else is left?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling folks about the repair drive now—want me to put your name down too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please put me down. I’ll stop by the repair drive later and bring a few things.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ve got you down. Thanks for bringing things by later—folks will really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — could you first confirm what items you can collect and when you’re available?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can collect tools, screws, tape, and small hand supplies, and I’m free this afternoon after 4 or tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’m pulling together a simple list of repairs, then we’ll match people to jobs and set a time to meet. If you’ve got tools or can help with hauling, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with hauling, and I’ve got a basic tool kit too. Send me the list when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m keeping things organized so we can help everyone on the block. What should we tackle first, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the biggest repairs first, then work down the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works for me, Bo—I’ll sort the list by biggest jobs first and we’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and whether we’ve got everything we need lined up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I hear you, Pia. Let’s make a simple checklist and a clear time, and we’ll know exactly what’s left to line up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot—if we can pin down the time and the checklist, I’ll feel much better about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam — what do you need me to grab while I’m out?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still piecing together what’s needed—if you hear what’s most in short supply, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know what folks say is running low.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand for the repair drive, then we’ll know what still needs picking up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm what we already have before we buy anything?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ll check the supplies we already have first, and then I’ll let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Jules — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’s really kind. If you can bring the basic tools and maybe a wrench set, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll grab the basic tools and a wrench set, then swing by. If anything else comes up, just give me a shout.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times for the repair drive. What day are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be so helpful, thank you. I was thinking Saturday morning for the repair drive — does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should work for me, as long as we finish before noon. I can help line things up around pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup, so just let me know the repair drive schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that would be a huge help. I’ll send you the repair drive schedule as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — send it over when you have it, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon, or did the time change?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details now—last I knew, it was still this afternoon, but I’ll confirm the exact time before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you let me know as soon as you confirm the time?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive, right? Just confirming—what exactly do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly tools and a few hands if you’ve got them—nothing fancy, just whatever you can spare. I can swing by and tell you the exact list if that’s easier.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, that’d help—can you swing by and give me the exact list? I just want to make sure I’ve got the right stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized now. If you’ve got any requests or know a neighbor who needs help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — we’re set on basics here, but I’ll ask around and send anyone your way who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list updated and let you know if anything urgent comes up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep things simple today.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — let’s keep it simple. I’ll bring the basics and we can handle one thing at a time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. That helps a lot—I’ll do my part and keep it to one task at a time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming up, but I’m still piecing together the details from everyone else. If you know what they need, I’d love the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy on the full list, honestly, but I know they’re looking for folks who can help fix small things and lend a hand. If I hear more, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps a lot — I’ll keep an ear out for the rest and spread the word if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive—just send me the basics and I’ll skim it. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, just the basics is fine — I’ll send over the repair drive details and you can skim them when you’ve got a minute.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send it over and I’ll skim it when I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — could you help organize the tools and sign people in as they arrive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can organize the tools and sign people in as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ve got some tools ready to lend if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Gus — I’ll tell people your tools are available too. That should help get more neighbors out and working.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, I’m a little late—did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You didn’t miss much yet—just the sign-up list and the tool drop-off spot by the community shed. We’re still waiting on a few people to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I'll sign up and swing by the shed to drop off a few tools. Let me know if you need me to check on the folks who haven’t confirmed yet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate it—just let me know if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll ask around and update you if I hear any news.
